text:
raj.k: FYI ran into confusing 403 vs 401 handling in the Python SDK when token refresh triggers — it raises a generic ApiError with message 'unauthorized' so callers can't tell whether to refresh or bail.
emma.w: Ugh yeah i've seen this too in sample-apps/chat. The SDK returns ApiError('Unauthorized') but status==403 which is wrong for expired tokens. We should map expired token -> 401 + AuthError.
arjun: Strong +1 for typed exceptions. If we had AuthError / PermissionError / RateLimitError as subclasses, caller code could do: try: ... except AuthError: refresh_token() except RateLimitError as e: sleep(e.retry_after)

laura_p: Also noticed background worker got stuck retrying on 403 because our retry logic treats 4xx as terminal. We probably need a clear retry hint in the exception shape.

raj.k: Here's a minimal repro of what the SDK emits (from logs):
```
Request POST /v1/generate -> 403 Unauthorized
redwood.errors.ApiError: Unauthorized
    at client._request (/.../client.py:98)
```
No status field or retry metadata on the exception object.

sam.j: Proposed mapping: 401 -> AuthError (retry: try refresh once), 403 -> PermissionError (do not retry), 429 -> RateLimitError (include retry_after header as hint), 5xx -> TransientError (safe to retry with backoff). Also include `http_status` and optional `retry_after` on exception object.
arjun: Agreed. Parity note: make sure Go/TS/Java SDKs expose the same typed hierarchy and the same fields (http_status, retry_after, ephemeral boolean). Breaking change surface can be minimized by keeping ApiError as base and adding subclasses.
emma.w: UX suggestion for message strings: be clear and actionable. e.g. AuthError: "token expired or invalid; attempt refresh". PermissionError: "missing scope: chat.write". RateLimitError: "rate limited; retry after Xs". Avoid raw 'Unauthorized'.

laura_p: We should also add a sample-app showing common patterns: refresh-on-AuthError, backoff-on-TransientError, fail-fast-on-PermissionError. That helped me debug last hour.

devex-bot: created DE-2012: "sdk: typed errors + status mapping + retry hints" and assigned to @arjun.

raj.k: Thanks — can we get a quick design doc? maybe a 1-pager with exception classes, fields, and example catch patterns. I can help test python + node parity.

arjun: I'll draft a short RFC today. Plan: add subclasses, ensure http_status & retry_after string field, add unit tests and sample-app update. Will post link once ready. :thumbsup:

sam.j: if we include a migration note, suggest adding small shim for callers that check error.message text. e.g. Deprecate string-match over 2 releases.
emma.w: perfect. also add docs section for CLI & quickstart so onboarding doesn't hit this again.

raj.k: great — leaving this here for visibility. ping me for testing. :rocket:
